condition: Consider only if FIFO urgency measurement shows material required-barrier delay. Do not add metadata or change current qualified source before evidence.
minimal_candidate: Within each existing worker queue, insert existing intrusive Dispatch node ordered lexicographically by immutable(due,serial,index). Head pop remains O(1). Tail monotonic fast append avoids scanning normal monotonic admissions. Out-of-order insert scans queue under only its local mutex; no allocation.
algorithm: Define less(a,b) from slots[a.claim.slot].due then claim.serial then claim.index. Due immutable while any job queued or executing; serial unique admission order. Existing serial rollover assumptions unchanged.

Under target queue mutex: if empty set head=tail=node; else if !less(node,*tail), append tail in O(1); else if less(node,*head), insert head; else walk predecessor until next greater, splice. Preserve tail when inserting at end.
Own pop, victim steal and optional rescue already remove head; no dispatch/completion allocation or heap buffer. Queue links remain manipulated under same local mutex.

Lane readiness unchanged: only head of ordered lane is enqueued. Sorted policy cannot make blocked successor ready or move optional callback context. Continuation retains original due/serial/index and may insert ahead of later due work.
ownership_proof: Every queued node prevents its batch terminal count: job cannot complete while still queued, and each lane promotion happens before predecessor terminal count. Fixed node vectors are freed only after all jobs terminal. Thus reading due/serial from live slot under local queue ownership is safe without owner mutex, provided no unrelated mutation of due until free/reuse. Due+serial initialized before queue publication; queue mutex synchronizes readers. Comparator must never retain a pointer after releasing queue ownership unless node is popped into local copy.
limitations: Local ordering is not global EDF: ownqueue-first worker can execute later-due head while another queue has earlier due. Stealer chooses first nonempty victim by rotation, not earliest among victims.

Tail fast append is common only for monotonic due admissions; async continuation and old lane successor can insert near head. Long queues can make promotion hold local mutex O(queue length), so compare actual queue depths and enqueue contention.
Sorting earlier due ready jobs changes internal execution order but preserves logical publication/lane contract. Still qualify required barriers, presentation fairness and per-tick simulation.
Do not add atomic global minimum or head metadata merely to claim restored EDF; it creates new consistency/wakeup machinery.

only_if_needed_later.cost: Peek own and one victim head under separate local locks then validate/pop selected queue; stale choice acceptable for heuristic. This improves urgency sampling, not global EDF guarantee; avoid nested queue locks.

Would require explicit due limit plus worker awareness or owner-context eligibility and an urgent wake protocol. Owner cannot blindly run job due to contexts/optional overlap and current no-assistance contract; not a small transparent change.

tests_if_built: Same-queue opposite due insertion, equal due serial/index stable order, tail append and head/middle insertion, queue empty/tail restoration.
Old deferred continuation/lane promotion ahead of younger jobs, no duplicate/missing jobs, serial slot reuse.
Actual cross-queue counterexample demonstrates local priority does not promise global EDF; retain urgency probe separate from correctness tests.
Held optional presentation rescue and bounded completion/error/async/teardown contracts remain unchanged.
acceptance: Retain only if measured barrier/game benefit outweighs local insertion scan and added comparator code. Default remain simplest measured winner; no production recommendation or timing claim.
